title: Pauli Invaders
tagline: Space Invaders meets quantum error correction: correct each error with the matching color.
description: Each invader is an X, Z or Y error, and only a shot of the matching color corrects it. A Y error equals X times Z, so red then blue works, or purple at once. In HARD mode a wrong color changes the error instead. Shoot the Cosmic Ray for power-ups, and face bosses like a crawling logical error, a wave packet that must be measured first and a syndrome lattice that hides its errors. For 1 or 2 players, sharing their lives.

keyboard.p1: W A S D to move, B to fire, V to switch color, Space to pause
keyboard.p2: Arrows to move, L to fire, K to switch color, Enter to pause

how_to_play: Move your ship and fire at the invading errors.
Only a shot of the error's color corrects it: switch color with B.
A Y error is X times Z: hit it with red and then blue, or with purple directly.
Don't let the errors reach the logical error threshold.
Start (Space or Enter) pauses the game.
